note:
r2 of BOTH explainer blocks on /pages/fine-lines-wrinkles — templates/page.fine-lines-wrinkles.json, section `content`, blocks `causes` and `approach`. Malcolm, 2026-08-26, rejecting r1: 'they need more contrast and saturation. These look far too faded. Also I prefer the style (look and feel) of the medical explainer images used on /pages/firming-skin-density and /pages/skin-repair-renewal.'

=== THE ROOT CAUSE OF r1, BECAUSE IT WILL RECUR OTHERWISE ===

THIS STORE HAS TWO DIFFERENT EXPLAINER FAMILIES AND r1 INHERITED THE WRONG ONE. Measured off the live CDN, 2026-08-26, over the saturated pixels of each image (sat > 0.18):

  RESEARCH pages  /pages/copper-peptide-research, /pages/matrixyl-3000-research
                  mean sat 0.087 and 0.388 — and 89% / 97% COOL hues. Teal and blue.
  SOLUTION pages  /pages/firming-skin-density, /pages/skin-repair-renewal
                  mean sat 0.143-0.186 — and 100% WARM hues. 0% cool. Coral, peach, rose.
  r1 (rejected)   mean sat 0.067 — 28-44% cool.

block-fine-lines-causes-explainer.json names its reference set explicitly as 'copper-peptide-research f1/f2/f3 and matrixyl-3000-research f1/f2/f3' — the RESEARCH family. But /pages/fine-lines-wrinkles is a SOLUTION page and sits in the same nav group as firming-skin-density and skin-repair-renewal. The teal was never right for this page; it was correctly copied from the wrong source. The r1 brief even congratulated itself for 'following what was selected, not what was specified' — it followed a real selection from a different page type.

'FADED' IS A MEASURABLE THING, NOT A MATTER OF TASTE. The share of pixels carrying visible colour at all: references 29-40%, r1 4-6%. The r1 frames were about 95% near-greyscale. That is the number to check a candidate against, and it is checked after generation by scripts, not by eye.

=== THE PALETTE, EXTRACTED FROM MALCOLM'S OWN REFERENCES ===

Median-cut quantisation of the three closest references gives a tight, consistent ladder. Every dominant colour in all three sits between hue 4 and hue 24 — peach, coral, rose, and nothing else anywhere in the frame:

  #F3E3DB  sat 0.09  warm blush-cream — background and the palest tissue
  #F2DACC  sat 0.16  pale peach — bulk tissue
  #E0B6A1  sat 0.27  mid coral-peach — the surface cell layer, the workhorse colour
  #CB8F76  sat 0.42  deep coral — the thin divider bands between strata
  #D37B75  sat 0.45  salmon-rose — fibre bundles in the skin-repair sub-style
  #F5EFE8            glossy cream-ivory — fibre bundles in the firming sub-style

CONTRAST IN THIS FAMILY IS BOUGHT WITH STRATA, NOT WITH SHADOWS. The references are high-key and shadowless, exactly as r1 was, and yet they do not read as flat — because each stratum is a DIFFERENT COLOUR AND A DIFFERENT GEOMETRIC MOTIF, stacked in hard-edged bands: velvety rounded pillows, then a thin laminated ivory sheet, then a dense field of tiny beads, then a saturated coral rule, then glossy fibre cables, then a coral rule again, then big pearl spheres. The eye reads the boundaries. r1 had three vague strata in one colour family and dissolved. If a candidate comes back with soft gradients between layers it has failed this brief however pretty it is.

=== TWO SUB-STYLES, BECAUSE MALCOLM NAMED TWO PAGES AND THEY DIFFER ===

FIRMING SUB-STYLE (slots A and C) — from /pages/firming-skin-density. Straight-on orthographic front elevation, the block square to camera, no perspective. Fibre bundles are GLOSSY CREAM-IVORY. Strata are horizontal hard-edged bands. The block stands on a thin clear glass plate. Background a warm blush-cream gradient.

SKIN-REPAIR SUB-STYLE (slots B and D) — from /pages/skin-repair-renewal. Isometric three-quarter cube seen from slightly above, floating with a soft warm shadow beneath, two faces visible. Fibre bundles are SALMON-ROSE #D37B75 running through a pink dermis. Cream rounded-cell layer above, cream fat spheres below. More saturated overall.

Both are legitimate; Malcolm picks. Every slot is generated in both blocks' subject matter so the pair can be chosen as a pair.

=== WHAT EACH BLOCK MUST ARGUE — UNCHANGED FROM r1, THE MECHANISM WAS NOT THE FAULT ===

CAUSES ('What Causes Fine Lines & Wrinkles?'): collagen and elastin breakdown, which is the root the other three listed causes act through — muscle movement etches lines 'as the collagen matrix weakens', UV 'break[s] down collagen and elastin fibers', glycation makes 'fibers stiff and brittle'. So: the deep scaffold thinned, parted and broken-ended, and the surface sagging into a crease above the loss. NOTHING ARRIVING. No spheres, no light beams, no glints — a picture of an active arriving under this heading argues against its own caption.

APPROACH ('The Peptide Approach to Wrinkle Reduction'): Matrixyl 3000 is two matrikines whose entire mechanism is a MESSAGE arriving and a FIBROBLAST answering — palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 is a fragment of collagen's own propeptide, so its presence in the dermis IS the signal 'collagen broke here', and the cell reads it and synthesises replacement. The page's own copy says so. The cell is therefore the hinge of the picture and is the element a generic 'active penetrating skin' frame omits. Here the arriving vocabulary is not only allowed but is the house brand signature: glassy spheres above the block holding pearl-bead peptide chains, fine white beams descending, starburst glints where they land. Both reference approach images use exactly this.

NEW FIBRE MUST BE DISTINGUISHABLE FROM OLD or the approach frame argues nothing. Healthy tissue is a texture, not a claim. Fresh strands brighter, smoother, more saturated and more evenly spaced than the dull slack ones they weave into, with a residual thinned zone left visible to measure against.

NO NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION IS DRAWN, in any slot. Acetyl Hexapeptide-8's described mechanism is SNAP-25 mimicry at the neuromuscular junction, and it is barred: the copy says the peptide helps 'visibly relax THE LOOK OF' expression lines, which is a cosmetic claim, whereas a nerve releasing vesicles onto a muscle asserts a pharmacological action on muscle, which is a drug claim — a picture can make a claim the text carefully avoided. It also reads as needle-free botox, the exact comparison the copy's own first paragraph distances itself from. The 'relax' half is carried by the surface easing its pleat, never by the muscle that made it.

=== GEOMETRY — MEASURED IN THE LIVE DOM 2026-08-26, DIFFERENT FOR THE TWO BLOCKS ===

  causes   (row 2)  TEXT-DRIVEN at every desktop width: 452x808 at 1024 (0.559), 680x825 at 1440 (0.823).
                    A square master keeps full height and loses width: only 56% shows at 1024, 82% at 1440.
  approach (row 3)  IMAGE-DRIVEN from 1280 up: 580x580, 660x660, 708x708 — square, delivered whole.
                    Text wins only in a band near 1024 (452x556, 0.813), ~9% off each side.

Both are square masters at 2048x2048. `media-with-text` has no aspect-ratio of its own, so the master's own aspect sets the row height and a non-square master would make the approach block the odd one out among six siblings.

COMPOSITION CONSEQUENCE: the causes frame loses up to 44% of its width, so its event must sit in the CENTRAL BAND with the outer fifth of each side left as empty warm haze. The approach frame is far more forgiving — outer tenth only. Both briefs below say so explicitly.

CLASS B, no reference images attached — every selected explainer on this store was generated class B with the style carried in the prompt. All six suppliers, two candidates each. FLUX.2 returns one per call and invents printed graduation digits on anything glassware-like; the glass base plate in the firming sub-style is exactly such a trigger, so check its candidates at full size for numbers. Remember `set -a` before sourcing credentials.

slots.title: A · CAUSES, firming sub-style — straight-on elevation, cream fibre broken, surface sagging
slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare advertising: glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key and shadowless, lit softly and evenly. Square format. WARM CORAL AND PEACH THROUGHOUT — every colour in the picture is a peach, coral, apricot or rose, richly and cleanly saturated, with no cool colour anywhere.

A rectangular block of skin is shown in cross-section SQUARE TO THE CAMERA, a straight-on front elevation with no perspective and no turn, filling the central three quarters of the frame and standing on a thin clear glass plate. The background is a smooth warm blush-cream gradient, colour hex F3E3DB, faintly glowing.

THE BLOCK IS BUILT OF DISTINCT HARD-EDGED HORIZONTAL BANDS, each a different colour and a different shape, stacked so the boundaries between them are crisp and instantly readable:
  1  Along the very top, a row of plump rounded velvety pillow shapes packed side by side, matte and soft, in a rich mid coral-peach, colour hex E0B6A1.
  2  Beneath them a thin laminated sheet of fine parallel ivory strands, smooth and slightly glossy, colour hex F5EFE8.
  3  Beneath that a dense field of thousands of tiny pale pink spheres packed tightly together like caviar, colour hex F2DACC.
  4  A thin crisp rule of deep saturated coral, colour hex CB8F76, separating the upper block from the deep zone.
  5  The deep zone, the tallest band: long thick glossy cream-ivory cables, colour hex F5EFE8, lying in loose horizontal waves and crossing one another, resting on a warm peach ground.
  6  Another thin crisp deep coral rule, colour hex CB8F76.
  7  Along the bottom, a double row of large smooth pearl-cream spheres packed together, softly iridescent.

THE CENTRE OF THE BLOCK HAS FAILED. In the middle of the deep zone the cream cables are thinned, slack and widely parted, and several have SNAPPED, their blunt cut ends drawn back from one another leaving a clear open gap of bare peach ground between them; a fine drift of tiny pale crumbs hangs in that gap. The tight field of pink spheres above has come loose there and scattered into the space, its packed edge dissolving into stray drifting beads. The pearl spheres along the bottom are smaller and squeezed in the middle.

BECAUSE THE SUPPORT BENEATH HAS GONE, THE WHOLE UPPER STACK SAGS INTO A SMOOTH VALLEY across the centre: the row of coral pillows dips down and their laminated sheet dips with it, unbroken but bowed. At the left and right ends of the block every band is thick, dense, evenly packed and perfectly level, so the loss reads as a change within one continuous piece of tissue.

NOTHING IS ARRIVING AND NOTHING IS BEING REPAIRED — the space above the block is empty warm background. The outer fifth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty background that can be cropped without losing anything. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical rather than alarming.

slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare advertising: glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key and shadowless, softly and evenly lit. Square format. WARM ROSE, CORAL AND PEACH THROUGHOUT — every colour is a peach, coral, salmon or rose, richly and cleanly saturated, with no cool colour anywhere.

A cube of skin is shown as an ISOMETRIC THREE-QUARTER BLOCK seen from slightly above, floating in the centre of the frame with a soft warm shadow beneath it, its top surface and two cut side faces all visible. The background is a smooth warm blush-cream gradient, colour hex F3E3DB, faintly glowing.

THE CUBE IS BUILT OF DISTINCT STRATA, each a different colour and a different shape, with crisp readable boundaries:
  1  The top surface is a mosaic of flat rounded plates fitted together like paving, in a soft warm peach, colour hex ECD0C5.
  2  Directly beneath, a band of plump glossy cream-white rounded cells stacked two or three deep, smooth and pearlescent.
  3  Beneath that the deep zone, the tallest band: a pale pink ground, colour hex F2DACC, through which run long thick glossy SALMON-ROSE cables, colour hex D37B75, in loose horizontal waves, crossing and overlapping. A few slender spindle-shaped cells lie among them.
  4  Along the bottom edge, a row of large smooth cream-ivory spheres packed together.

THE CENTRE HAS FAILED. Through the middle of the deep zone the rose cables are thinned, dull and widely parted, and several have SNAPPED — their blunt ends drawn back from one another with a clear open gap of bare pink ground between them, and a scatter of short orphaned fibre pieces and fine crumbs drifting in the space. Toward the left and right of the cube the same cables are thick, springy, evenly spaced and richly saturated rose.

DIRECTLY ABOVE THE FAILED CENTRE THE SURFACE HAS CREASED: the paved top plates fold down into a single deep smooth furrow that runs across the cube, the plates tilting into it and the cream cell band beneath compressed and sagging under the fold, unsupported. Where the cables are still dense the surface is flat, taut and level.

NOTHING IS ARRIVING AND NOTHING IS BEING REPAIRED — the space above the cube is empty warm background. The outer fifth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty background that can be cropped without losing anything. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical rather than alarming.
